tagline: Price and mood barometer of the French-language watch press.
imageFlagsHint: Articles flagged for using comic-book imagery or suspected of being AI-generated.
introBody: Baromontres scans businessmontres.com daily to measure the unit price of paywalled articles, editorial sentiment and the brands they mention. Horology readers get a quick read on what's driving the specialist press — from the price of a single dossier to the most-cited brands, plus a sample of doctored or AI-generated images surfaced by our classifier.
